name: Asenapine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Cleared mainly by UGT1A4 glucuronidation and CYP1A2 oxidation, with smaller CYP3A4/CYP2D6 contributions. Metabolites include asenapine N-glucuronide and N-desmethylasenapine; elimination occurs through urine and feces.
